# CodeRa
> CodeRa is a Chrome extension that extracts formatted code from video frames and screenshots. Free during early access, no sign-up. Extract path: CodeRa relay → Anthropic API.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://codera.click/)
- [Privacy](https://codera.click/privacy.html)
- [Terms](https://codera.click/terms.html)
- [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/codera/achdkjdakdpnihgjhdgmodgamefkffid)

## Product facts
- Shortcut: Alt+C captures the current video frame while playback continues
- Modes: plain text, extract as code, understand code
- Capture also via floating button, select area, or image upload
- Local snippet library in the browser; optional exports
- AI: Anthropic Claude API via CodeRa HTTPS relay (see Privacy)
- Author: Anton Zakharenka · hello@codera.click
